# AGENTS.md

Instructions for AI agents (and humans) working in this repository.

**Cross-Store Owned** (`cross-store-owned@inklikeurine.dev`) is one Firefox extension, generated by AI
under human direction. This repository is the extension and nothing else: its
root is the folder Firefox loads (`manifest.json`, code, `icons/`, `docs/`),
plus these repo files.

## The workshop

The rules, the validator, the test harness, this extension's tests, fixtures
and verification journal live in a **private workshop** next to this repo:
`../_workshop/` (`inklikeurine/firefox-workshop`), shared by every extension
in `~/src/firefox/`. Read its rules before changing anything:

@../_workshop/AGENTS.md

Commands are run from this repo's folder, e.g.
`node ../_workshop/tools/check.mjs cross-store-owned`. The Claude Code hook in
`.claude/settings.json` runs the validator after every edit and skips quietly
when the workshop is absent.

## Without the workshop

On a clone without `../_workshop/`, the essentials still apply, done by hand:

- `docs/spec.md` is the product spec; read it before changing behaviour.
- Every change to a shipped file (anything but `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`,
  `docs/` and the repo files) bumps `version` in `manifest.json` (semver)
  and adds a dated `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
- `web-ext lint --source-dir . --warnings-as-errors --ignore-files AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md UNLICENSE`
  must pass (CI runs it on every push).
- No `package.json`, bundler, `eval`, remote code or inline scripts.
  Unlicense only, no file headers.
- Never claim the extension was tested in a real browser session; only a
  human ticks Manual Review.
